rules.title: Install Raised Pedestrian Table & Active Pedestrian Refuge
rules.why_dangerous: High density of vulnerable pedestrians crossing in unprotected traffic streams with approach vehicle speeds exceeding safe braking distance.
rules.recommended_fix: Construct a 100mm raised tabletop zebra crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings, refuge island, and solar-powered flashing pedestrian beacons.
rules.verification_metric: Pre vs post close-call events per 1,000 pedestrian crossings via automated zone conflict monitoring.
rules.assumption: Assumes standard driver compliance with raised crossings as documented in IRC:99-2018 guidelines.

rules.title: Implement Optical Speed Bars & Parabolic Speed Tables
rules.why_dangerous: Vehicles maintain high cruising speeds on approach to merge/conflict points, drastically increasing stopping distance and kinetic severity.
rules.recommended_fix: Deploy transverse thermoplastic optical speed bars 100m prior to junction, coupled with calibrated 75mm parabolic speed cushions.
rules.verification_metric: 85th percentile approach speed reduction measured across 7-day post-installation sample windows.
rules.assumption: Speed reduction model assumes 85th percentile drop of 12-18 km/h based on FHWA countermeasure synthesis.

rules.title: Deploy High-Mast Warm-White LED Illumination & Class XI Retroreflective Signs
rules.why_dangerous: Inadequate ambient lighting and low contrast diminish driver hazard recognition distance below safe perception-reaction thresholds.
rules.recommended_fix: Erect 12m twin-arm LED lighting fixtures (minimum 40 lux on road surface) and upgrade all intersection guide signs to microprismatic diamond-grade sheeting.
rules.verification_metric: Photometric lux audit (>35 lux uniform) and night-time near-miss conflict rates.
rules.assumption: Visibility risk correlation assumes normal reaction time increases by 0.7s in unlit wet conditions.

rules.title: Apply High-Friction Epoxy Surfacing (HFST) & Drainage Trench Regrade
rules.why_dangerous: Surface water film diminishes tire skid resistance (micro-texture loss), causing extended hydroplaning risk during deceleration.
rules.recommended_fix: Lay a 5mm calcined bauxite epoxy high-friction surfacing treatment and clear roadside cross-drainage conduits to eliminate pooling.
rules.verification_metric: Skid resistance value (SRV > 65) verified by British Pendulum Tester, and wet-weather braking distance logs.
rules.assumption: Skid resistance restores braking friction coefficient from 0.32 to 0.68 under saturated conditions.

rules.title: Activate Variable Speed Limit (VSL) 20 km/h & Crossing Marshal Protocol
rules.why_dangerous: Surge of school children crossing concurrently with parent pick-up vehicular chaos creates dense blind-spot conflict vectors.
rules.recommended_fix: Auto-trigger dynamic flashing 20 km/h school signs during 07:30-08:45 and 14:00-15:30; deploy traffic warden at primary pedestrian gate.
rules.verification_metric: Zero near-miss collisions inside 200m school perimeter during 30-minute peak bell intervals.
rules.assumption: Calculated assuming 92% speed compliance when active flashing beacons and uniformed warden are visible.

rules.title: Designate Dynamic Emergency Green Corridor & Left-Turn Free Flow
rules.why_dangerous: Spillback queues block emergency ambulance ingress/egress, triggering erratic evasive maneuvers into oncoming lanes.
rules.recommended_fix: Implement emergency green-wave preemption on signal controllers and physical bollards preventing queue spilling into ambulance slip lanes.
rules.verification_metric: Average emergency response traversal time through the junction under 75 seconds during peak hours.
rules.assumption: Green-wave clearance assumptions based on NTCIP 1202 preemption standards.

rules.title: Adaptive Split-Cycle Retiming & Downstream Diversion Advisory
rules.why_dangerous: Tail of queue spills back into preceding intersection box, provoking illegal weaving and red-light entrapment.
rules.recommended_fix: Increase green allocation on primary arterial by 18 seconds; push dynamic upstream variable message sign (VMS) advisory to divert non-essential traffic.
rules.verification_metric: Reduction of maximum queue length to under 35 meters within two signal cycles.
rules.assumption: Assumes Webster minimum delay cycle re-optimization formula.

rules.title: Immediate Cold-Mix Asphalt Patching & High-Priority Work Order
rules.why_dangerous: Deep edge-break and potholes cause sudden severe two-wheeler swerving, loss of balance, and vehicle tire rupture.
rules.recommended_fix: Dispatch fast-response maintenance squad for cold-lay polymer modified asphalt compaction within 24 hours, followed by structural mill-and-fill.
rules.verification_metric: Automated post-repair road scan re-verification index with zero D40/D20 depressions remaining.
